integrity: Contains a full derivation based on an established bijection and a self-contained direct enumerator. The relevant descent-only result is acknowledged as previously known.
scientific_limitations: The result treats two copies per letter; no all-k formula, limit law, or priority guarantee beyond the cited literature is asserted. The polynomial expansion is proved combinatorially, with independent finite checks through order eight.
title: Joint descent–plateau enumeration of flattened Stirling permutations
